oneOf.description: Opens a registered processing tool with the record chosen; the tool writes by its own rules.
The form's calculations again on the record (`cad.forms.recompute`).
A workflow step on the record (`cad.forms.transition`).
The record shown on the drawing; writes nothing.

ActionRuns.description: Where a `tool` action's tool runs (İşlemler's “Nerede çalışır”, docs/adr/0124).

oneOf.description: On this computer, in the window's thread.
In the background, with its panel and Durdur.

AttachmentAccept.description: What an attachments item counts and adds.

oneOf.description: Photos, files and addresses.
Only photos (a PNG or JPEG asset, or a link ending in one).
Only what is not a photo: documents and addresses.
When the record is saved: not while the value is typed.

When the record goes forward in the form's workflow (a step); a form without a workflow asks it
when the record is saved.
Once its field was left (focus moved on, a list's value chosen), and on saving (docs/adr/0760 §1).

FormBody.description: A form's content: its items and the draft's revision (each kept change adds one).

clearHidden.description:
A write through the form empties the fields the record hides (docs/adr/0402 §3); written only
as `true`. Without it a hidden field keeps its value.

revision.description: Raised by one with every saved change to the draft: an update names the revision it was made on.

scope.description:
Kapsam (docs/adr/0539): an expression over the layer's fields and the `@` values; a Veri girişi
reads and writes, through this form, only the records it holds true for (`@kullanici`,
`@kullanici_eposta` the person signed in). None: every record of the layer. At most
`MOST_SCOPE_LETTERS` letters.

steps.description:
Adım adım (docs/adr/0437): the tabs are steps, taken in order with Geri and İleri; a step with
an error is not left forward. Only a form of tabs; written only as `true`.

tests.description:
The designer's scenarios (docs/adr/0420): values typed into a record and what the form made of
them, run again whenever the form changes.

translations.description:
The form's words in other languages (docs/adr/0443 §5), by language tag (`en`, `de`, `ar`): its
name and its items' labels and help. Only what is shown changes; the values, codes and rules are
the form's own.

workflow.description:
The records' workflow (docs/adr/0428): their state, the steps between states, the states that
lock a record.

FormCheck.description:
A check of a field: an expression that must be true when the field is shown and filled, and what
the form says when it is not.

on.description:
When it is asked (docs/adr/0438 §2); none: as the value changes. A check asked later is still
asked of every save that reaches it: the moment only says when the form shows it.

warning.description: A soft check: when not true it warns and the record is still written; written only as `true`.

FormComment.description: A reviewer's comment on a form or one of its items (docs/adr/0441 §5).

author.description: Who wrote it and when (as the command was given them).

id.description: 1, 2, …: one more than the form's last.

item.description: The item it is about; none: the form.

FormItem.description: An item of a form: a tab (only at the top), a group, a field or a note.

oneOf.description:
A tab: its items show when it is chosen. Tabs stand at the top only, and then the top holds
nothing but tabs.

visibleWhen.description: The tab is shown while it holds (docs/adr/0426): a record's kind may have tabs of its own.

oneOf.description: A group: a titled box of items, in one or two columns, that a rule may hide.

across.description:
In two columns, filled a row at a time: Tab goes across, then down (docs/adr/0443 §6); else
down the first column, then the second. Written only as `true`.

collapsed.description: It opens closed (its title opens it); written only as `true`.

oneOf.description: A field of the layer.

calculate.description:
The field's value, worked out from the record at every write; the field is read-only. Not
with `default`, `defaultExpr` or `readOnlyWhen`.

checks.description: What the record must satisfy, in order.

choiceFilter.description:
Asked of each of the field's listed values: `@secenek` is its code, `@secenek_etiketi` its
label; a value it is not true for is not offered.

default.description:
The value an empty field shows when the form opens, in the field's canonical text; written
only when the record is saved.

defaultExpr.description:
The value of a new record's empty field: an expression over the record (its plain defaults
in), evaluated in the form's order. Not with `default`.

field.description: The layer field's key ([`LayerField::key`](crate::LayerField::key)): its stable id or its name.

id.description: The item's id, unique in the form.

label.description: The label; none: the field's alias or name.

lookup.description:
The field's values from another layer (docs/adr/0404 §1). Not with the field's own list or
`choiceFilter`.

minSearch.description:
A searched list searches once this many letters are typed (docs/adr/0439 §6); none: from the
first.

mirror.description:
A mirror (docs/adr/0437): the field's value shown again, read-only, where the form needs it; the
field's own item elsewhere writes it. Only its label, help, widget and visibility rule. Written
only as `true`.

overridable.description:
The calculation may be overridden (docs/adr/0417): it fills the field while the field is
empty, the field stays open to typing, and emptying it calculates it again. Only with
`calculate`; written only as `true`.

readOnly.description: Shown, never edited; written only as `true`.

readOnlyWhen.description: Locked when this expression is true.

redact.description:
Kept out of the recorder's examples (docs/adr/0443 §2): the field's values are written as
`‹gizli›` in the Python and replay a call is copied as. Written only as `true`.

required.description:
May not be left empty while shown; written only as `true`. The layer field's own `required`
holds as well.

requiredWhen.description: Required when this expression is true (and the field is shown).

reuseLast.description:
A new record's field opens with the value last written through the form in the session (the
form's interface keeps it); written only as `true`.

suggest.description:
The layer's values of the field offered while typing, the value staying free (docs/adr/0407
§3): text fields without a list; written only as `true`.

unique.description: No two objects of the layer have the same value (empty ones aside); written only as `true`.

visibleWhen.description: Shown only when this expression is true (the record's fields by name).

widget.description: How it is edited; none: the field kind's own.

oneOf.description:
A line of text: a hint for whoever fills the form. A `{…}` in it is an expression put in with
the record's value (docs/adr/0225 §6's templates; docs/adr/0402 §1).

The objects of another layer whose field holds this record's persistent id (docs/adr/0404 §4):
a list in the form, each opened by its own form.

actions.description:
What it lets do with the children (docs/adr/0762 §1), each once; none: every action but
deleting; empty: the children only listed.

columns.description: The table's columns: the other layer's fields' keys, at most 8; empty: its first four.

field.description: Its field's key that holds this record's id.

min.description:
The fewest related objects (0–1000) the record holds while the item is shown: 1 a child it
must have (docs/adr/0444 §1).

view.description: How the objects are shown (docs/adr/0425): a list of their names, or a table of `columns`.

oneOf.description:
The record's photos and documents (docs/adr/0407 §1): the object's own attachments, added
and removed in the form; their count may be bounded.

accept.description: What counts and is added: every attachment, only photos or only documents and addresses.

min.description: The fewest (0–100) the record holds while the item is shown.

oneOf.description:
The record's place (docs/adr/0433): its shape on a small map, its centre's coordinates and its
area or length; nothing is written.
A divider (docs/adr/0441 §2): a line across the form, its title on it, that a rule may hide.

An action (docs/adr/0441 §6, 0442 §5): a button of a declared kind on the record: a registered
processing tool by its id, the form's calculations again, a workflow step by its label, or the
record shown on the drawing; no address, query or script.

runs.description: Where a `tool` action's tool runs (docs/adr/0442 §6); written unless `auto`.

step.description: A `step` action's workflow step, by its label.

tool.description:
A `tool` action's processing tool id (`attributes.calculate`): letters and digits in dotted
parts.

FormLookup.description: A field's list of values from another layer (docs/adr/0404 §1, docs/adr/0439 §1).

columns.description:
Its layer's fields shown beside a value's label in the list and under the chosen value
(docs/adr/0439 §2), in order; at most [`MOST_LOOKUP_COLUMNS`].

copy.description:
The chosen object's fields copied into the record's when the value is chosen (docs/adr/0439
§3): a copy, kept when the source changes.

duplicates.description: What a code held by more than one of the list's objects is (docs/adr/0439 §4).

filter.description: Asked of each of the list's objects (its fields by name, the project's `@` values).

key.description: Its field's key whose value is written; `$uid`: the object's persistent id (a reference).

label.description: Its field's key shown; none: the key's.

limit.description:
How many values a page of the list holds (docs/adr/0439 §1): a form's state carries the
first ones and the count of the rest; searching reaches them all. None: every value.

matches.description: The list's object is offered when its field equals the record's (a chain: il, ilçe, mahalle).

sort.description: The list's order (docs/adr/0439 §1): by a field of its layer; none: the labels' natural order.

spatial.description: Only the list's objects standing so to the record's geometry are offered (docs/adr/0439 §5).

stamp.description:
A text field of the record that is told where the copy came from (docs/adr/0439 §3): the
layer, the code, the copied values' fingerprint and the day.

FormRelease.description: A frozen copy of a form's body: what data entry and the write profile use.

digest.description: The first 32 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the body's canonical JSON ([`body_digest`]).

fields.description:
The layer's fields the body binds as they were at publishing ([`bound_fields_digest`]): a
release whose fields changed since is said (docs/adr/0444 §2). None: published before it was kept.

note.description: What changed, as the publisher wrote it.

version.description: 1, 2, …: one more than the release before.

FormTest.description:
A scenario of a form (docs/adr/0420): a record's typed values and what the form showed, required,
locked, wrote and said for them.

name.description: Unique in the form; trimmed, 1–64 characters.

new.description: A new record: the form's defaults fill it. Written only as `true`.

values.description: The values typed, by the layer fields' keys, onto an empty record.

attrs.description: The record after the form: its attributes by the fields' names.

issues.description: What the form said: each issue's code, `@` and its item when it has one (`form_required@not`).

shown.description: The items shown, required and read-only, by their ids in the form's order.

FormTranslation.description: A form's words in one language (docs/adr/0443 §5).

name.description: The form's name; none: its own.

oneOf.description: One line of text.
Several lines of text.
A number: integer or decimal fields.
A date (YYYY-AA-GG).
A check box: yes or no fields.
A switch: yes or no fields.
A drop-down list: fields with a value list.
Radio buttons: fields with a value list.
A segmented choice: fields with a short value list.
A slider between the field's least and most (docs/adr/0406 §2): number fields with both.
A colour, `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (docs/adr/0407 §2): text fields.
A check box for each listed value (docs/adr/0408 §2): multiple fields, and only they.
A list searched by typing (docs/adr/0431): single-valued fields with a long value list.
The codes held as chips, one added from a list (docs/adr/0431): multiple fields with a value list.

A tree of the list (docs/adr/0437): its labels' “Üst / Alt” parts as branches; single-valued
fields with a value list. The codes are the list's.

FormWorkflow.description:
A form's workflow (İş akışı, docs/adr/0428): a listed field holds each record's state; a step
(`cad.forms.transition`) takes a record from one state to another, the form valid when the step
says so and a reason written when it names one; a locked state's record is read-only until a step
takes it out.

drafts.description:
The draft states (docs/adr/0432): a record in one may be kept incomplete, the form's own
requirements warn; the layer's and the subtype's still refuse.

field.description: The state field's key: a single-valued field with a value list.

initial.description: The state a new record starts in: a code of its list.

locked.description: The states whose records are read-only.

log.description:
A text field's key each step appends a line to (docs/adr/0429): the moment, the person, the step,
the states and the reason; read-only in the form.

steps.description: The steps, in their order (the editor's buttons).

ItemWords.description:
An item's words in a language: its label (a tab's, group's, field's, list's or action's title, a
note's text) and its help line.

choices.description: A listed field's values' labels by their codes; the codes written are the list's own.

placeholder.description: A field's text shown in it while empty.

LookupCopy.description: A field of the chosen object copied into a field of the record.

LookupDuplicates.description: What a code held by more than one of the list's objects is (docs/adr/0439 §4).

oneOf.description: The first object's is taken and a record holding it is warned (`form_lookup_duplicate`).
The first object's is taken, as chosen.
A record may not hold it (`form_lookup_duplicate`, an error).

LookupMatch.description: A field of the list's layer that must equal a field of the record.

fold.description:
Compared without regard to case, Turkish letters folded (`İ` and `i`, `I` and `ı`), ends
trimmed (docs/adr/0439 §4); written only as `true`. Numbers are compared by their values.

LookupRelation.description: How a list's object stands to the record's geometry.

oneOf.description: The object holds the record (a building's parcel).
The record holds the object.
They have a point in common (within the tolerance).
The nearest object (within the tolerance, when given); ties by the list's order.

LookupSort.description: A list's order by a field of its layer.

descending.description: The greatest first; written only as `true`.

field.description: The field's key: numbers by value, dates as written, text in natural order; empty ones last.

LookupSpatial.description: The objects of the list a record's geometry takes (docs/adr/0439 §5).

tolerance.description: How far apart still counts, in the drawing's unit; none: 0 (nearest: any distance).

RelatedAction.description:
What a related item lets the record's user do with its children (docs/adr/0762 §1): the form's
offer; whether the user may is asked apart (the child layer's lock, the project role).

oneOf.description: Yeni: a child made, linked to the record.
A child's values changed: its form opens to edit, `cad.forms.submit`'s child values.
A child deleted (Sil), after it is asked.
Bağla: an object of the child layer linked to the record.
Bağı kopar: a child's link to the record taken off.
Aç: a child's form opened to read.
Git: a child shown and chosen in the drawing.

RelatedView.description: How a related item shows its objects (docs/adr/0425).

oneOf.description: Their names, one a line.
A table of the item's columns, the numbers totalled under them.
A card for each child: its columns' labels and values, as its form names them (docs/adr/0440 §6).

A bar for each value of its first column, as long as the children holding it are many
(docs/adr/0441 §3).

from.description: The states it is taken from; empty: any state.

label.description: The button's words, unique in the workflow: “Gönder”, “Onayla”, “Geri gönder”.

reason.description: A text field's key the step writes its reason to; it must be given.

valid.description: The record must be valid by the form (no error) to take it.

description: Projenin bir formu: kimliği, adı, katmanı, taslağı ve yayınları (docs/adr/0401, 0434). Bilinmeyen alan reddedilir; yayının özeti gövdesinin kanonik JSON'unun SHA-256'sıdır.

comments.description: The reviewers' comments on the form, oldest first (docs/adr/0441 §5).

enforce.description:
The latest release's rules hold for every attribute write on the layer (the write profile);
written only as `true`, and only with a release.

id.description: Stable, unique in the project: letters, digits, `-`, `_` and `.`; 1–64 characters.

layer.description: The layer the form edits: a layer's id (not a group's).

name.description: What the lists show; trimmed, 1–64 characters.

releases.description: The frozen releases, oldest first; data entry uses the last.

withdrawn.description:
Yayından kaldırıldı (docs/adr/0445 §1): no record is written through it; a window open on it keeps
what was typed. Written only as `true`, and only with a release.

title: KentOS formu, sürüm 1
